name: CheckpointWorkingCopy
pure_preflight: validate WorkingCopyKey through closed edit-surface registry
validate draft_contract_id/version and dirty paths through WorkingCopyContractRegistry
canonicalize StrictVersionedJson and require <=262144 UTF-8 bytes
compute content_hash; count nonexpired copies only when creating a new key
transaction_boundary: one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork; writes only ui_working_copies plus command/audit metadata
guards: authenticated singleton local user owns the row
expected_generation=0 requires absence; otherwise exact generation match
new row rejected at 256 nonexpired copies
draft contract remains registered/current enough to checkpoint
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; semantic replay returns prior result; identical content against current generation is NO_CHANGE and does not increment generation
receipt_order: revalidate/no-change -> insert command_receipt -> insert/update ui_working_copies -> metadata-only audit/result -> commit
mutations: insert new recoverable row generation=1 or replace validated payload/base token and increment generation
revision_effects: working-copy generation increments only on changed checkpoint; no domain revision changes
